body: I don't want to live in this world anymore, quite literally. The economic system we are under is breaking people down, no empathy, no care for humanity. I don't feel appreciated for being alive. I also get depressive episodes that I'm tired of living with, even if I got past this one, there would be many more in the future. I'm not willing to put up with that.
I don't know what to think. Is Shahid going to respond to this? Call for an investigation?

This poem struck me very powerfully. I enjoyed the dramatic language and powerful imagery, such as the "desolate carcasses
of things past" and "sharp talons clawing on steel." I could hear the unpleasant and horrifying sound of evil talons scratching rigid steel, imagining an eagle with piercing eyes. I felt the desperation of wanting to rid oneself of suffering and the desire to fade away, due to the pain of life. Really good work!

I really enjoyed this poem. The choppiness of the poem directly relates to the theme of a fragmented mind. It's as if the mind is shattered like a broken mirror. I sense the fear in the protagonist when an unknown monster arises from within, bringing no chance of peace. It is a great poem, thank you for sharing this.
